title: Benchmark Sensitivity: Do Different Interpretability Methods Agree on Which Circuit Matters?
original_idea: Pick a well-studied task (e.g., IOI) on GPT-2 Small. Apply three methods using TransformerLens: attention head ablation, mean activation patching, and SAE feature importance scores. Compute agreement scores (Jaccard similarity, rank correlation) across method pairs.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Crystal clear: one task, three methods, Jaccard/rank-correlation metrics. Deliverable is a comparison table.
